records.source: Well hello there! I'm Gus, chef and owner of the Stardrop Saloon.#$e#Stop in if you need any refreshments. I've always got hot coffee and cold beer at the ready.$h
records.translation: Aba, kumusta! Ako si Gus, kusinero at may-ari ng Saloon ng Patak-Bituin.#$e#Dumaan ka kung may kailangan kang makakain o maiinom. Palagi akong may nakahandang mainit na kape at malamig na serbesa.$h

records.source: Oh wow, thank you! I'm tempted to drink all of it, but I'm going to save some for the saloon. I bet I could make an interesting cocktail with this!
records.translation: Ah, wow, salamat! Natutukso akong inumin ang lahat, pero magtitira ako para sa saloon. Tiyak na makagagawa ako ng kawili-wiling cocktail gamit ito!

records.source: *sniff*... Ah. Exquisite cuisine. You know what I like, @.$h
records.translation: *singhot*... Ah. Napakasarap na lutuin. Alam mo ang gusto ko, @.$h

records.source: *sniff* sniff* ... that sharp smell!#$b#*slurp* *slurp* ... that zesty taste! That gritty texture!#$b#It can only be gourmet tomato salt! I'll trade you for it.
records.translation: *singhot* *singhot*... ang tapang ng amoy!#$b#*lagok* *lagok*... ang anghang ng lasa! Ang gaspang ng tekstura!#$b#Tiyak na Pinong Asin ng Kamatis ito! Ipapalit ko ito sa iyo.

records.source: I saw the weather report last night. It really gave me a scare!$s#$e#Are there monsters out there? What's happening?
records.translation: Napanood ko ang ulat-panahon kagabi. Talagang natakot ako!$s#$e#May mga halimaw ba sa labas? Ano ang nangyayari?

records.source: I'm glad that's over. Running the saloon is enough to worry about, I don't need exotic weather in my life!
records.translation: Natutuwa akong tapos na iyon. Sapat nang alalahanin ang pagpapatakbo ng saloon; hindi ko kailangan ng kakaibang panahon sa buhay ko!

records.source: *sniff*... These rains have a particular smell. Have you noticed? Almost like freshly minced herbs...
records.translation: *singhot*... May natatanging amoy ang ulang ito. Napansin mo ba? Halos parang bagong tinadtad na mga yerba...

records.source: Lewis tells me your tomatoes have ripened. That's great news!#$b#...Just imagine what the culinary world would be like without tomatoes...
records.translation: Sabi ni Lewis, hinog na ang mga kamatis mo. Napakagandang balita!#$b#...Isipin mo na lang kung ano ang magiging mundo ng pagluluto kung walang kamatis...

records.source: It's important to me that people can eat healthy, delicious meals. Unfortunately, in today's world, that's not so easy for everyone.
records.translation: Mahalaga sa akin na makakain ang mga tao ng masustansiya at masarap na pagkain. Sa kasamaang-palad, hindi iyon madali para sa lahat sa mundo ngayon.

records.source: Hey @, just want to say that I'm happy for you and %spouse.
records.translation: Uy, @, gusto ko lang sabihing masaya ako para sa inyo ni %spouse.

records.source: Emily has a real pep in her step lately... I wonder why? *wink*
records.translation: Napakasigla ni Emily nitong mga nakaraan... Bakit kaya? *kindat*

records.source: Hey, I'm sorry to hear about the break-up...$s#$e#If you need company, you're always welcome at the Saloon.
records.translation: Uy, ikinalulungkot kong marinig ang paghihiwalay ninyo...$s#$e#Kung kailangan mo ng kasama, palagi kang malugod na tatanggapin sa Saloon.

records.source: Another failed marriage? Well, it happens. Guess I'll be seeing you at the Saloon more often...$s
records.translation: Isa na namang bigong pag-aasawa? Aba, nangyayari iyon. Mukhang mas madalas na kitang makikita sa Saloon...$s

records.source: Hey, you really pulled through with those eggs. The omelet turned out great, thanks to you!
records.translation: Uy, talagang nailigtas mo ang sitwasyon sa mga itlog na iyon. Napakaganda ng omelet dahil sa iyo!

records.source: Hey, @! Glad you're here. I'm gonna be serving up some good stuff from behind the bar.
records.translation: Uy, @! Natutuwa akong narito ka. Maghahain ako ng masasarap na bagay mula sa likod ng bar.

records.source: I'll see you back home, @.
records.translation: Magkita tayo sa bayan, @.

records.source: Meet me at the bar if you need a beverage.
records.translation: Puntahan mo ako sa bar kung kailangan mo ng inumin.

records.source: Hey, need a drink? I've got some special beverages that showcase local ingredients from this island.$h
records.translation: Uy, gusto mo ng inumin? Mayroon akong mga natatanging inuming tampok ang mga lokal na sangkap mula sa islang ito.$h

records.source: These might be the best crab cakes I've ever made...
records.translation: Maaaring ito na ang pinakamasasarap na mga keyk ng alimango na nagawa ko...

records.source: Yeah, I know a lot about the people living here.#$e#That's one of the benefits of being a bartender.$h#$e#Sometimes I hear too much...
records.translation: Oo, marami akong alam tungkol sa mga taong naninirahan dito.#$e#Isa iyon sa mga pakinabang ng pagiging bartender.$h#$e#Minsan, sobra ang naririnig ko...

records.source: Hey. I heard what you did for Pam. That was really really nice of you!$h#$e#Sadly, I don't think it will get her to cut back on the 'beverages'...
records.translation: Uy. Narinig ko ang ginawa mo para kay Pam. Napakabait mo talaga!$h#$e#Nakalulungkot, pero sa tingin ko ay hindi niya babawasan ang “mga inumin” dahil doon...

records.source: I saw Pam earlier today... she was grinning from ear to ear! She said someone bought her a new house!#$e#Whoever it was, they truly deserve the best!$h
records.translation: Nakita ko si Pam kanina... abot-tainga ang ngiti niya! Sabi niya, may bumili sa kaniya ng bagong bahay!#$e#Sinuman iyon, talagang karapat-dapat siya sa pinakamabuti!$h

records.source: Welcome to the Stardrop Saloon! Can I get you anything?
records.translation: Maligayang pagdating sa Saloon ng Patak-Bituin! May maihahain ba ako sa iyo?

records.source: Hi there, @. Make yourself at home.
records.translation: Kumusta, @. Huwag kang mahiya.

records.source: Hi, Pierre!/Now, what do I need.../Ah, that looks good!/Makin' my special sauce tonight!/Pierre! What's fresh?/Pierre! Waddya got for me?
records.translation: Kumusta, Pierre!/Ngayon, ano ang kailangan ko.../Ah, mukhang maganda iyan!/Gagawa ako ng espesyal kong sarsa ngayong gabi!/Pierre! Ano ang sariwa?/Pierre! Ano ang mayroon ka para sa akin?

records.source: Hi there @. I'm glad to see you! You're always welcome here.
records.translation: Kumusta, @. Natutuwa akong makita ka! Palagi kang malugod na tinatanggap dito.

records.source: Hi! Please relax and enjoy yourself.
records.translation: Kumusta! Magpahinga ka at magsaya.

records.source: Hey, you look like you could use a beverage.
records.translation: Uy, mukhang kailangan mo ng inumin.

records.source: Business has been really good tonight. I'm pleased.
records.translation: Napakaganda ng negosyo ngayong gabi. Natutuwa ako.

records.source: I sell different dishes each week, so make sure and check in every now and then!#$e#You might taste something spectacular.$h#$e#Just let me know if you have any allergies.$s#$e#Okay, see you around.
records.translation: Iba-ibang pagkain ang ibinebenta ko bawat linggo, kaya tiyaking dumaan paminsan-minsan!#$e#Baka makatikim ka ng pambihirang putahe.$h#$e#Sabihin mo lang kung may allergy ka.$s#$e#Sige, magkita tayo.

records.source: Emily's been working here for a while now. I don't know what I'd do without her!#$e#I would hate to have to clean all those pots by myself.$s
records.translation: Matagal-tagal na ring nagtatrabaho rito si Emily. Hindi ko alam ang gagawin ko kung wala siya!#$e#Ayaw na ayaw kong linisin nang mag-isa ang lahat ng kalderong iyon.$s

records.source: Pam and Clint come into the saloon almost every night.#$e#I'd probably go out of business if they stopped coming.$h#$e#So make sure you don't drive them away!
records.translation: Halos gabi-gabing pumupunta sa saloon sina Pam at Clint.#$e#Malamang malulugi ako kung tumigil silang pumunta.$h#$e#Kaya tiyaking hindi mo sila itataboy!

records.source: Clint comes into the saloon almost every night and sits at the same table by himself.#$e#Sometimes he glances over at Emily with a nervous look. Hmmm.#$e#Maybe that's why he comes in so often. Oh well, that means more business for me.
records.translation: Halos gabi-gabing pumupunta si Clint sa saloon at mag-isang umuupo sa parehong mesa.#$e#Minsan ay kinakabahan siyang sumusulyap kay Emily. Hmmm.#$e#Baka iyon ang dahilan kung bakit madalas siyang pumunta. Ayos lang, dagdag na negosyo iyon para sa akin.

records.source: Pam comes into the saloon almost every night and drinks way too much beer.#$e#Ah well, I shouldn't pass judgment on my customers.
records.translation: Halos gabi-gabing pumupunta si Pam sa saloon at umiinom ng napakaraming serbesa.#$e#Aba, hindi ko dapat hinuhusgahan ang mga parokyano ko.

records.source: Hi there, @. If you're ever thirsty, the Saloon is the place to be.
records.translation: Kumusta, @. Kung nauuhaw ka, Saloon ang tamang lugar.

records.source: I don't actually drink very much myself. I'm mainly doing this to make a living.#$e#Although I do enjoy a taste of the Stardew Valley vintage from time to time.
records.translation: Hindi naman talaga ako umiinom nang marami. Pangunahing ginagawa ko ito para kumita.#$e#Pero nasisiyahan akong tumikim ng piling alak ng Stardew Valley paminsan-minsan.

records.source: Are you much of a chef, @?#$e#If you have a kitchen and some recipes, you can cook some useful dishes.#$e#Home-cooked meals make great gifts, as well.
records.translation: Mahilig ka bang magluto, @?#$e#Kung may kusina at ilang resipe ka, makapagluluto ka ng ilang kapaki-pakinabang na pagkain.#$e#Mahusay ding regalo ang lutong-bahay.

records.source: Business has been pretty steady thanks to my regular customers.
records.translation: Medyo matatag ang negosyo dahil sa mga suki ko.

records.source: Ah, Mayor Lewis told me you just arrived. I'm Marnie!#$e#I sell livestock and animal care products at my ranch. You should swing by some time.$h
records.translation: Ah, sabi ni Mayor Lewis ay kararating mo lang. Ako si Marnie!#$e#Nagbebenta ako ng mga alagang hayop at produktong pangangalaga sa hayop sa rantso ko. Dumaan ka minsan.$h

records.source: Wow, thanks a million, @. I won't forget this!
records.translation: Wow, maraming-maraming salamat, @. Hindi ko ito malilimutan!

records.source: Thanks, @. I always like to have a copy of the Almanac around. It's pretty accurate!$h
records.translation: Salamat, @. Gusto kong laging may kopya ng Almanake. Medyo tumpak iyon!$h

records.source: I think you'll love having a little friend on the farm with you.
records.translation: Sa tingin ko, magugustuhan mong may munting kaibigan sa bukid.

records.source: I'm sure %pet will be a little shy at first. It takes a while for an animal to get comfortable in a new setting.
records.translation: Tiyak na medyo mahiyain si %pet sa simula. Matatagalan bago maging komportable ang isang hayop sa bagong kapaligiran.

records.source: Has little %pet settled in yet? It's such a nice property for a pet to explore.
records.translation: Nasanay na ba si %pet? Napakagandang ari-arian nito para galugarin ng isang alaga.

records.source: I just remembered... it's been about a year since you adopted %pet. I bet you two have grown really close by now!
records.translation: Naalala ko lang... Halos isang taon na mula nang ampunin mo si %pet. Tiyak na napakalapit na ninyong dalawa ngayon!

records.source: Oh, you got a horse? That's so wonderful! Horses are amazing animals.$h
records.translation: Ah, may kabayo ka na? Napakaganda! Kahanga-hangang mga hayop ang kabayo.$h

records.source: Shane seems a lot more positive and hopeful, lately.#$b#I'm so happy you moved here, and that you two get along so well!$h
records.translation: Mukhang mas positibo at umaasa si Shane nitong mga nakaraan.#$b#Tuwang-tuwa akong lumipat ka rito at napakaganda ng samahan ninyong dalawa!$h

records.source: I'm glad Shane's moving to your farm... he can keep the family tradition alive!
records.translation: Natutuwa akong lilipat si Shane sa bukid mo... Mapapanatili niyang buhay ang tradisyon ng pamilya!

records.source: Hehe... finally a chance to show off all my hard work at aerobics club.$h
records.translation: Hehe... Sa wakas, pagkakataon nang ipakita ang lahat ng pinaghirapan ko sa samahan ng aerobics.$h

records.source: I feel warm.
records.translation: Mainit ang pakiramdam ko.

records.source: Hee hee... It's interesting to see everyone in their bathing suits.
records.translation: Hee hee... Kawili-wiling makita ang lahat na nakasuot ng panlangoy.

records.source: Ew... the chair's wet.
records.translation: Ew... basa ang upuan.

records.source: Phew... It's hot!$s
records.translation: Hay... Ang init!$s

records.source: Gah!$4#$b#...Um... What? Heh.. I don't know what that is...$3
records.translation: Gah!$4#$b#...Um... Ano? Heh... Hindi ko alam kung ano iyan...$3

records.source: I love animals, Mr. @. If you treat yours well I'm sure we'll become good friends!^I just love animals, Ms. @. Treat them kindly and we'll become friends, I'm sure!
records.translation: Mahilig ako sa mga hayop, Ginoong @. Kung aalagaan mo nang mabuti ang sa iyo, tiyak na magiging mabuti tayong magkaibigan!^Mahilig ako sa mga hayop, Binibining @. Alagaan mo sila nang mabuti at tiyak na magiging magkaibigan tayo!

records.source: Animals are so innocent, so sweet. And If I don't look after them, who will?$s#$e#I just hope my chickens aren't too upset when I take their eggs.$s
records.translation: Napakawagas at napakabait ng mga hayop. At kung hindi ko sila aalagaan, sino ang gagawa?$s#$e#Sana hindi masyadong malungkot ang mga manok ko kapag kinukuha ko ang mga itlog nila.$s

records.source: You've been here a while, now... how's your farm doing?#$e#Taking care of animals is easy as long as you don't forget about them!$h
records.translation: Matagal-tagal ka na rito... Kumusta ang bukid mo?#$e#Madaling mag-alaga ng mga hayop basta hindi mo sila nakakalimutan!$h

records.source: Now that I'm here I can finally relax and socialize a bit.
records.translation: Ngayong narito ako, makapagpapahinga at makikisalamuha na rin ako nang kaunti.

records.source: There aren't very many people here today...$s
records.translation: Hindi gaanong marami ang mga tao rito ngayon...$s

records.source: #$1 marnieAnimalSal#I spilled a whole bucket of milk on the floor today, it was horrible. And such a waste of my poor Belinda's hard work.$k$s#$e#It's nice of you to show up! It's a little more lively now.
records.translation: #$1 marnieAnimalSal#Naitapon ko sa sahig ang isang buong timba ng gatas ngayon. Nakakakilabot iyon, at sayang na sayang ang pinaghirapan ng kaawa-awang Belinda ko.$k$s#$e#Ang saya namang dumating ka! Medyo mas buhay na rito ngayon.

records.source: Phew! It sure feels good to kick back after a hard day's work.
records.translation: Hay! Ang sarap talagang magpahinga matapos ang isang araw ng puspusang trabaho.

records.source: %Marnie doesn't seem to notice that you're there...
records.translation: %Mukhang hindi napapansin ni Marnie na naroon ka...

records.source: *sigh*... I wasn't very productive today.
records.translation: *buntong-hininga*... Hindi ako gaanong naging produktibo ngayon.

records.source: I always see Clint here but he won't talk to anyone. He just glances over his shoulder now and then.$s
records.translation: Palagi kong nakikita rito si Clint, pero wala siyang kinakausap. Sumisilip lang siya sa likod niya paminsan-minsan.$s

records.source: $query PLAYER_NPC_RELATIONSHIP any Shane married roommate#Now that Shane's gone, I'm going to have to teach Jas how to care for the chickens.|My nephew Shane has been staying at my place the last few months.#$e#He helps me out with the chickens, so I'm not complaining.
records.translation: $query PLAYER_NPC_RELATIONSHIP any Shane married roommate#Ngayong wala na si Shane, kailangan kong turuan si Jas kung paano alagaan ang mga manok.|Ilang buwan nang nakatira sa akin ang pamangkin kong si Shane.#$e#Tinutulungan niya ako sa mga manok, kaya wala akong reklamo.

records.source: You're not worried about this rain? That does put me at ease a little...#$e#I just hope the cows tucked themselves in...$s
records.translation: Hindi ka nag-aalala sa ulang ito? Medyo napapanatag ako roon...#$e#Sana nakasilong nang maayos ang mga baka...$s

records.source: Well, looks like we all got scared for nothing... The rain was totally harmless!
records.translation: Aba, mukhang natakot tayong lahat nang walang dahilan... Hindi pala mapanganib ang ulan!

records.source: The animals seems to enjoy this rain... I think it's putting extra nutrients into the grass.
records.translation: Mukhang nasisiyahan ang mga hayop sa ulang ito... Sa tingin ko, nagdaragdag ito ng sustansiya sa damo.

records.source: You can use a scythe to cut feed from grass.#$e#Or you can buy it from me, of course!$h#$e#I could use the cash...$u#$e#Adios.
records.translation: Maaari kang gumamit ng karit upang pumutol ng kumpay mula sa damo.#$e#O maaari mo itong bilhin sa akin, siyempre!$h#$e#Kailangan ko rin ng pera...$u#$e#Paalam.

records.source: Hi. Need something?#$e#I might be getting some different kinds of animals in the future.#$e#Although, I'll need to make sure there's a market for them, so you'll have to prove your skill with animals first.#$e#Just keep treating your animals with respect and good things will happen.
records.translation: Kumusta. May kailangan ka?#$e#Baka magkaroon ako ng iba’t ibang uri ng hayop sa hinaharap.#$e#Pero kailangan kong tiyaking may pamilihan para sa mga iyon, kaya kailangan mo munang patunayan ang galing mo sa mga hayop.#$e#Patuloy mo lang igalang ang mga hayop mo at may mabubuting mangyayari.

records.source: You can catch me at the saloon most nights.#$e#Animals are great company, but I need to spend time with people, too.
records.translation: Makikita mo ako sa saloon sa karamihan ng mga gabi.#$e#Mahusay na kasama ang mga hayop, pero kailangan ko ring makasama ang mga tao.

records.source: I wonder if Mr. Lewis gets lonely in that big house of his... $s#$e#It seems so empty in there, doesn't it?
records.translation: Nalulungkot kaya si G. Lewis sa malaking bahay niya... $s#$e#Mukhang napakahungkag doon, hindi ba?

records.source: Have you been to that strange tower west of my house?#$e#One time I heard this terrible, otherworldly noise coming from there.$s#$e#I would avoid that place if I were you...
records.translation: Nakapunta ka na ba sa kakaibang tore sa kanluran ng bahay ko?#$e#Minsan ay may narinig akong kakila-kilabot at ingay na tila mula sa ibang daigdig mula roon.$s#$e#Iiwasan ko ang lugar na iyon kung ako sa iyo...

records.source: Hey there, it's good to see ya!#$e#Feel free to visit us any time you please.
records.translation: Uy, masayang makita ka!#$e#Malaya kang dumalaw anumang oras.

records.source: Hi @!$h#$e#I'm glad we've become friends. I know I can trust you to take care of my dear animals.
records.translation: Kumusta, @!$h#$e#Natutuwa akong naging magkaibigan tayo. Alam kong mapagkakatiwalaan kitang alagaan ang minamahal kong mga hayop.

records.source: Well, here goes nothing...
records.translation: Aba, susubukan ko na...

records.source: Well, I didn't win... but it was still satisfying to share all my hard work!
records.translation: Aba, hindi ako nanalo... pero kasiya-siya pa ring ibahagi ang lahat ng pinaghirapan ko!

records.source: That was some strange-looking purple lettuce in your grange display!$h#$b#I swear, it looked just like Mayor Lewis' special und... $3#$b#Oh!... heh... never mind!$4
records.translation: Kakaiba ang hitsura ng lilang letsugas na iyon sa eksibit mo sa Perya!$h#$b#Isinusumpa ko, kamukhang-kamukha iyon ng natatanging panlo... ni Mayor Lewis $3#$b#Ah!... heh... huwag na lang!$4
